proposedValue.excerpt: Herndon, Va. October 3, 2022 – Expel , the managed security provider that aims to make security easy to understand, use and improve, today announced that it has increased its Series E funding round , led by Alphabet’s independent growth fund CapitalG and Paladin Capital Group to $171.3 million.
